## AlgoArchive 2.5.0

- Refreshed the offline handbook and navigation. Keyboard shortcuts are now clearly separated from Windows desktop and Start menu `.lnk` launch shortcuts.
- Added a complete first-run C++ compiler guide: download the pinned MinGW-w64 GCC 8.1.0 archive, verify its SHA-256, extract the complete toolchain, choose `bin\g++.exe`, save settings, run the capability probe, and pass addition test cases.
- Added direct links to compiler and shortcut settings, and clear recovery steps when the local service is stopped or an application HTML file is opened directly.
- The static demo offers the Windows download instead of a shortcut creation button. Its handbook opens demo settings without probing the local machine.
- Windows release builds rebuild the native launcher, check installer and launcher versions, validate handbook resources and exercise problem CRUD and shutdown with the bundled Python runtime.
- Updated user-facing version references and documentation cache keys. The compiler archive is unchanged; its SHA-256 is `81a7de2010a66fa1a17b328bc9b8d7534596fe294d078d2cf4b6b706b083af97`.
